encoder.name: UNI2-h
encoder.license: CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 (academic, non-commercial; do not redistribute checkpoint files)
encoder.gated_access_check: huggingface_hub.HfApi().model_info('MahmoodLab/UNI2-h') succeeded authenticated inside environment.sif on a Hydra compute node; gated='auto'

architecture.loading_recipe: timm.create_model('hf-hub:MahmoodLab/UNI2-h@<commit_sha>', pretrained=True, cache_dir=<local_pin_root>, **timm_kwargs); pin the exact commit in the model id string, not 'main', or offline loading fails to resolve the ref
architecture.pooling: token (global_pool='token', per config.json; single CLS-style pooled vector, not concatenated with mean patch tokens like Virchow2)

transform.resolved_from: timm.data.resolve_data_config(model.pretrained_cfg, model=model) + timm.data.transforms_factory.create_transform, measured on the pinned checkpoint
transform.note: identical ImageNet normalization to Virchow2's transform; resize/crop policy differs by encoder and is applied to the same source pixels per protocol (no forced common transform)

inference.amp_qualification: not yet performed; protocol requires qualifying mixed precision against the float32 reference before adopting it (deferred to phase 03/04)
inference.storage_dtype: float16 planned to match the existing Virchow2 cache convention; conversion error not yet measured (deferred, per protocol line 28)

gpu_pilot.ran_on: gpu-test partition, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070, apptainer run --nv experiments/environment.sif
gpu_pilot.images: 8 TCGA-UT + 8 BRACS real patches bound from their production SquashFS images

checks.identical_patch_order: verified by index alignment; not separately perturbed in this pilot

gpu_pilot.note: gpu-test assigns a consumer RTX 4070, the weakest tier on Hydra; bulk extraction should request a stronger constraint (80gb/40gb/h100/mig40) for the array/shard jobs in phase 03

contamination_audit.note: phase 02 requires auditing public UNI2-h pretraining-description overlap with TCGA-UT/BRACS and reporting any unresolved overlap; UNI2-h's pretraining corpus (200M tiles, 350k+ H&E/IHC slides, Mass General Brigham) is not TCGA- or BRACS-sourced per the model card, but this has not been cross-checked against TCGA-UT/BRACS provenance beyond reading the card text, and silence is not treated as proof of no contamination
